description: Vesihuoltolaitosten tunnusluvut is a search tool on the Finnish water information service vesi.fi that brings together key figures for every water utility operating in Finland. The page read on 2026-09-28 says the tool contains the basic data of all Finnish water utilities together with data on water treatment and drinking water quality, and lets users search by municipality or organisation name or find the drinking water distribution area serving a street address. Coverage is national, for all utilities. Access is free in the browser; no licence or bulk download is stated on the tool page, and the publisher section was not opened. Caveats: the fields shown per utility (connections, volumes, treatment processes) were not listed on the page read, and figures depend on utilities' own reporting. It supports capacity planning and service resilience studies of Finnish water supply, such as linking addresses to supply zones and treatment plants. Related record: data-ilmasto-opas-finland-climate-impact-maps complements it with climate impacts on Finnish water resources.
